summary: Expose Personal, Studio and Control desktop experiences through server-verified roles while retaining owner-only runtime authority and sharing only a closed source-count summary with granted Control viewers.
data_boundary_changes: Explicit server ID grants may read a closed census summary. Raw owner reports, task history, provider account data and runtime execution remain owner-only.
Privileged desktop IPC requires a trusted sender and fresh server-verified owner permission; renderer-supplied identity never grants authority.
contract_changes: GET /api/workspace/access returns the verified caller's role, workspaces and explicit permissions. Only the configured owner ID receives runtime authority.
GET /api/workspace/summary independently authorizes Control access and returns allowlisted counts, observation time and closed status values with private no-store headers.
The development-only workspace preview uses synthetic identity and disconnected data. Studio simulations perform local fixture assertions without providers or runtime authority.

adr.reason: Records server-managed role grants, privileged native operations and the sanitized nonowner reporting boundary.

verification: Focused workspace access, summary, page and middleware tests
Desktop IPC sender and owner-authority tests
Site tests, lint, typecheck and production build
Canonical architecture declaration and registry reconciliation by the integrating task
